data.long_meaning: The name Yoshiko originated from the Japanese language, and it is composed of two parts: ‘yoshi’ which means ‘good’ or ‘joy’, and ‘ko’ which means ‘child’ or ‘small’. This name was popular among the Japanese people and was used for both boys and girls. The name carries a positive meaning and symbolizes the joy of having a child or the good qualities of a child.

This name was especially appreciated in missionary communities as a testament to the positive impact of Christian teachings in Japan.
